FN-L5IV9AA-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 122
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Economic Development
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 122 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the State Board of
Registration for Foresters until October 1, 2030 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
